const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path('.')
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w66-20261005'
workset = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
new_targets = json.loads((task / 'NEW-TARGETS.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
items = {row['entry_revision_identity']: row for row in workset['items']}
assert set(items) == set(new_targets)
manifest = load_manifest(version='tome-1.7.6', manifest_path=None)
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
expected = {}
for rev, row in items.items():
    nt = new_targets[rev]
    key = (row['normalized_path'], row['source'], row['source_tag'], row['target_preimage'])
    assert key not in expected, f'duplicate expected key: {rev}'
    expected[key] = (rev, nt['new_target'])
seen = {}
counts = Counter()
for file in sorted({row['normalized_path'] for row in items.values()}):
    baseline_path = task / 'baseline' / file
    baseline_bytes = baseline_path.read_bytes()
    predicted = baseline_bytes
    file_revs = sorted(rev for rev, row in items.items() if row['normalized_path'] == file)
    for rev in file_revs:
        old = new_targets[rev]['old_target'].encode('utf-8')
        new = new_targets[rev]['new_target'].encode('utf-8')
        assert predicted.count(old) == 1, f'{rev}: baseline preimage count != 1'
        predicted = predicted.replace(old, new, 1)
    current_bytes = (root / file).read_bytes()
    assert current_bytes == predicted, f'{file}: textual bytes differ beyond exact target substitutions'
    before = loader.load_path(baseline_path, logical_path=file).records
    after = loader.load_path(root / file, logical_path=file).records
    assert len(before) == len(after), f'{file}: record count changed'
    for index, (old_rec, new_rec) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
        if old_rec == new_rec:
            continue
        differing = {key for key in set(old_rec) | set(new_rec) if old_rec.get(key) != new_rec.get(key)}
        assert differing == {'target'}, f'{file}#{index}: non-target fields changed: {sorted(differing)}'
        key = (file, old_rec['source'], old_rec.get('source_tag'), old_rec['target'])
        assert key in expected, f'{file}#{index}: unexpected target change'
        rev, wanted = expected[key]
        assert new_rec['target'] == wanted, f'{rev}: target != new_target'
        assert rev not in seen, f'{rev}: changed more than once'
        seen[rev] = (file, index, hashlib.sha256(wanted.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest())
        counts[file] += 1
assert set(seen) == set(items), f'missing revisions: {sorted(set(items)-set(seen))}'
assert sum(counts.values()) == 25
print('LuaJIT semantic load: PASS (baseline and current, 4 files)')
print('Changed targets:', sum(counts.values()), dict(sorted(counts.items())))
print('Other records/fields unchanged: PASS')
print('Exact new_target match: PASS')
for rev in sorted(seen):
    file, index, digest = seen[rev]
    print(f'{rev}\t{file}\trecord={index}\tnew_target_sha256={digest}')
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path('.')
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w66-20261005'
workset = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
new_targets = json.loads((task / 'NEW-TARGETS.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

    key = (row['normalized_path'], row['source'], row['source_tag'], row['target_preimage'])
    assert key not in expected, f'duplicate expected key: {rev}'
    expected[key] = (rev, new_targets[rev]['new_target'])
seen = {}
counts = Counter()
line_metadata_changes = 0
for file in sorted({row['normalized_path'] for row in items.values()}):
    baseline_path = task / 'baseline' / file
    predicted = baseline_path.read_bytes()
    file_revs = sorted(rev for rev, row in items.items() if row['normalized_path'] == file)
    for rev in file_revs:
        old = new_targets[rev]['old_target'].encode('utf-8')
        new = new_targets[rev]['new_target'].encode('utf-8')
        assert predicted.count(old) == 1, f'{rev}: baseline preimage count != 1'
        predicted = predicted.replace(old, new, 1)
    current = (root / file).read_bytes()
    assert current == predicted, f'{file}: bytes differ beyond exact target substitutions'
    before = loader.load_path(baseline_path, logical_path=file).records
    after = loader.load_path(root / file, logical_path=file).records
    assert len(before) == len(after), f'{file}: record count changed'
    for index, (old_rec, new_rec) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
        old_content = {k: v for k, v in old_rec.items() if k != 'line'}
        new_content = {k: v for k, v in new_rec.items() if k != 'line'}
        if old_rec.get('line') != new_rec.get('line'):
            line_metadata_changes += 1
        if old_content == new_content:
            continue
        differing = {key for key in set(old_content) | set(new_content) if old_content.get(key) != new_content.get(key)}
        assert differing == {'target'}, f'{file}#{index}: non-target content changed: {sorted(differing)}'
        key = (file, old_rec['source'], old_rec.get('source_tag'), old_rec['target'])
        assert key in expected, f'{file}#{index}: unexpected target change'
        rev, wanted = expected[key]
        assert new_rec['target'] == wanted, f'{rev}: target != new_target'
        assert rev not in seen, f'{rev}: changed more than once'
        seen[rev] = (file, index, hashlib.sha256(wanted.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest())
        counts[file] += 1
assert set(seen) == set(items), f'missing revisions: {sorted(set(items)-set(seen))}'
assert sum(counts.values()) == 25
print('LuaJIT semantic load: PASS (baseline and current, 4 files)')
print('Changed targets:', sum(counts.values()), dict(sorted(counts.items())))
print('Other semantic records/fields unchanged: PASS')
print('Exact new_target match: PASS')
print('Expected loader line-metadata shifts:', line_metadata_changes)
for rev in sorted(seen):
    file, index, digest = seen[rev]
    print(f'{rev}\t{file}\trecord={index}\tnew_target_sha256={digest}')
